string-array.name: description
string-array.item: Kobudei is the Kotlin User Group for developers in Bucharest.
We organize events for technical presentations, open discussions regarding the many ways Kotlin has improved the community's approach to delivering concise, reliable and fast software.
Our intended purpose is to cover all areas regarding Kotlin's ecosystem: Syntax, targeted platforms, performance, community support and feedback as well as migration steps.
We wish to reach out to any who are interested to participate in any way, whether it be a tech talk, a training session or perhaps a local uni course.
